reviewType: Fresh-context independent read-only R3 prospective connector policy review
checks: Read governing repository instructions, REV18 policy and supplement, BUILD_STATE, operative handoff, accepted-stage evidence, R2 completion context and R3 kickoff.
Inspected the complete 13-path candidate change set.
Verified clean exact candidate HEAD, baseline ancestry and delivered-baseline ancestry.
Recomputed manifest SHA256, complete changed-path equality and all 13 candidate Git-blob hashes.
Verified BUILD_STATE changes only R3 status and the exact connectorSupplement object; its supplement equals the recorded authority scope.
Verified complete prior handoff and both kickoff documents remain byte-identical suffixes; canonical plan and decisions retain their complete prior contents as prefixes.
Verified unchanged original scope and connector proposal SHA256 pins.
Reverified original policy and connector-proposal reviews against their own manifest digests, immutable candidates and every listed candidate blob.
Confirmed no changes to product implementation, mappings, publications, fixtures, dependencies, deployment configuration, historical receipts or review records.
Independently ran revision-sanitizer synthetic tests, R3 governance tests and npm run r3:policy:check: PASS.

Confirmed sanitizer rejects missing current token, absent or ambiguous matching record, mismatched modifiedTime, foreign file identity, unexpected fields, incompatible MIME type and the 1000-record cap.
Confirmed sanitizer returns only minimal revision evidence and does not reproduce synthetic editor names, addresses, permission identifiers, photo links or raw error contents.
Independently ran build-plan validation from web: exit 1 with exactly the three reserved REV18 diagnostics.
Independently ran baseline-to-candidate git diff --check: PASS.
Inspected recorded typecheck, full tests and build successes, plus supplemental synthetic-test evidence.

assessment.authority: The recorded approved, proceed grant implements only the exact previously reviewed metadata supplement. Original R3 authority remains intact.
assessment.bounds: One revision page of at most 1000 records per observation, four observations per attempt and three attempts; no pagination or revision contents. Original workbook, sheet0, A1:O417 and cell projection remain exact.
assessment.privacy: The policy requires discarding editor attribution and raw spreadsheetUrl before model-facing output or persistence. The revision sanitizer retains only minimal permitted proof.
assessment.revisionProof: A tool-reported currentRevisionId must have exactly one matching revision record whose modification time agrees with independently observed file modifiedTime. Missing or ambiguous proof remains blocking.
assessment.preservation: Original capture, reconciliation, mapping-review and product gates, historical authority, completed operations, recovery/hold triggers and all reserved effects remain unchanged.
assessment.continuation: Commit this matching supplemental policy review before additional authorized source calls. Source reconciliation and mapping review still precede product edits.
assessment.release: This prospective policy PASS neither completes R3 nor supplies canonical acceptance or any R4 release authority.

errors: PLAN-REV18 requires a committed manifest/review attestation in current history

limits: Review applies only to this exact prospective supplemental policy candidate and manifest.
No live source calls, source capture, source reconciliation, application-health verification or provider verification were performed.
The sanitizer was tested with synthetic responses; actual connector compatibility remains unknown until authorized execution.
Observation counts, cell-envelope sanitization and complete capture gates must still be enforced during subsequent orchestration.
The recorded full typecheck/test/build matrix was inspected rather than repeated; targeted tests and plan validation were independently rerun.
Reviewer-only initial checks used an incorrect validation working directory and an incorrect historical review JSON field location; corrected read-only checks passed without file changes.
The three reserved canonical diagnostics remain explicit failures.
